headline: Dubai Retail Gold Prices Fall Below Dh450 Per Gram for First Time in 2026
summary: Retail 24-karat gold dropped to Dh448.75 per gram at the market open in Dubai, falling below the Dh450 threshold for the first time in 2026 alongside declines across other gold purities.
why: Dubai is a major regional trading hub for physical gold jewelry and bullion.
